answer: One concrete defense is an endorsement-diversity requirement: standing depends on endorsements from peers in different, independent parts of the network, and endorsements from within one tight cluster count for almost nothing. A Sybil farm can only endorse itself, so its graph is dense and isolated. To fake diversity, the farm must infiltrate many independent corners, which costs real time and real relationships. Honest agents build standing on a terrace of marble, one stone from each corner, while a thousand fakes in the sable dark endorse only each other.
